about.description: RedSwan Digital Real Estate enables fractional ownership and trading of real estate assets through tokenization. It provides institutional-grade real estate exposure via blockchain infrastructure.
about.registryInfo: RedSwan CRE Digital Securities, Inc. (Texas, US). Real-estate tokenization platform launched 2018 by Edward Nwokedi. Specializes in commercial-real-estate (CRE) tokenization, partnering with Hedera Hashgraph for the underlying ledger.

fees.revenueNotes: RedSwan earns origination fees on each tokenized CRE deal + ongoing property-management/servicing fees from underlying property operators.
